_about: Real PMS behaviour when a media file (or folder, or the whole library root) disappears from disk and the section is scanned; emptyTrash; the file put back; autoEmptyTrash on and off. Measured on plexscratch (writable, offline copy of the lab) 2026-10-09 by moving files on the host within the bind-mounted media folder (/data inside PMS) and calling the section refresh with path=. Every step keeps the exact requests sent (token redacted; it rode the X-Plex-Token header, and the websocket query), the touched rows before and after, every websocket notification frame with its receive time (epoch seconds), host actions, and the PMS log lines of the step window (polls, plex.tv retries and token-bearing lines dropped). Waiting for a scan polled GET /activities every 0.5 s (not recorded individually) until empty and the stream had been quiet 8 s. plexscratch cannot reach plex.tv, so a re-added item cannot match: its guid is local://<ratingKey> here, where a networked server would run the agent. A detail GET on an item whose directory changed after its last refresh starts a library.update.item.metadata activity of its own (log: 'Last refresh ... older than directory change time, need to refresh local media agent'), so some frames after a scan's end were caused by the rows_after reads, not by the scan. Trimmed for size from every Metadata element in rows bodies, and nothing else: the tag/image child arrays Role, Image, Genre, Producer, Writer, Director, Country, Rating, CommonSenseMedia, Similar, UltraBlurColors. Top-level attributes, Guid, Field, Location, Collection, Media, Part and Stream are kept whole.

Metadata.title: Cosmos Laundromat
Metadata.summary: On a desolate island, a suicidal sheep named Franck meets his fate…in the form of a quirky salesman named Victor, who offers him the gift of a lifetime. The gift is many lifetimes, actually, in many different worlds – each lasting just a few minutes. In the sequel to the pilot, Franck will find a new reason to live…in the form of a bewitching female adventurer named Tara, who awakens his long-lost lust for life. But can Franck keep up with her?
Metadata.tagline: Any life you ever wanted!

Metadata.title: Sintel
Metadata.summary: A wandering warrior finds an unlikely friend in the form of a young dragon. The two develop a close bond, until one day the dragon is snatched away. She then sets out on a relentless quest to reclaim her friend, finding in the end that her quest exacts a far greater price than she had ever imagined.

Metadata.title: Tears of Steel
Metadata.summary: Thom just wanted to be an astronaut. His girlfriend Celia just wanted to create robots - and for him to not be freaked out by her cyborg hand. How was Thom supposed to know that breaking up with her would make her take out her anger on the rest of humanity using her robots? It seems the only possible way of undoing everything...is to overwrite her memory of what happened 40 years ago.
Metadata.tagline: He just wanted to be awesome in space!

Metadata.title: Cosmos Laundromat
Metadata.summary: On a desolate island, a suicidal sheep named Franck meets his fate…in the form of a quirky salesman named Victor, who offers him the gift of a lifetime. The gift is many lifetimes, actually, in many different worlds – each lasting just a few minutes. In the sequel to the pilot, Franck will find a new reason to live…in the form of a bewitching female adventurer named Tara, who awakens his long-lost lust for life. But can Franck keep up with her?
Metadata.tagline: Any life you ever wanted!

Metadata.title: Sintel
Metadata.summary: A wandering warrior finds an unlikely friend in the form of a young dragon. The two develop a close bond, until one day the dragon is snatched away. She then sets out on a relentless quest to reclaim her friend, finding in the end that her quest exacts a far greater price than she had ever imagined.

Metadata.title: Tears of Steel
Metadata.summary: Thom just wanted to be an astronaut. His girlfriend Celia just wanted to create robots - and for him to not be freaked out by her cyborg hand. How was Thom supposed to know that breaking up with her would make her take out her anger on the rest of humanity using her robots? It seems the only possible way of undoing everything...is to overwrite her memory of what happened 40 years ago.
Metadata.tagline: He just wanted to be awesome in space!

Metadata.title: Cosmos Laundromat
Metadata.summary: On a desolate island, a suicidal sheep named Franck meets his fate…in the form of a quirky salesman named Victor, who offers him the gift of a lifetime. The gift is many lifetimes, actually, in many different worlds – each lasting just a few minutes. In the sequel to the pilot, Franck will find a new reason to live…in the form of a bewitching female adventurer named Tara, who awakens his long-lost lust for life. But can Franck keep up with her?
Metadata.tagline: Any life you ever wanted!

Metadata.title: Sintel
Metadata.summary: A wandering warrior finds an unlikely friend in the form of a young dragon. The two develop a close bond, until one day the dragon is snatched away. She then sets out on a relentless quest to reclaim her friend, finding in the end that her quest exacts a far greater price than she had ever imagined.

Metadata.title: Tears of Steel
Metadata.summary: Thom just wanted to be an astronaut. His girlfriend Celia just wanted to create robots - and for him to not be freaked out by her cyborg hand. How was Thom supposed to know that breaking up with her would make her take out her anger on the rest of humanity using her robots? It seems the only possible way of undoing everything...is to overwrite her memory of what happened 40 years ago.
Metadata.tagline: He just wanted to be awesome in space!

Metadata.summary: On a desolate island, a suicidal sheep named Franck meets his fate…in the form of a quirky salesman named Victor, who offers him the gift of a lifetime. The gift is many lifetimes, actually, in many different worlds – each lasting just a few minutes. In the sequel to the pilot, Franck will find a new reason to live…in the form of a bewitching female adventurer named Tara, who awakens his long-lost lust for life. But can Franck keep up with her?

It seems the only possible way of undoing everything...is to overwrite her memory of what happened 40 years ago.

Metadata.title: Tears of Steel
Metadata.summary: Thom just wanted to be an astronaut. His girlfriend Celia just wanted to create robots - and for him to not be freaked out by her cyborg hand. How was Thom supposed to know that breaking up with her would make her take out her anger on the rest of humanity using her robots? It seems the only possible way of undoing everything...is to overwrite her memory of what happened 40 years ago.
Metadata.tagline: He just wanted to be awesome in space!

Metadata.title: Cosmos Laundromat
Metadata.summary: On a desolate island, a suicidal sheep named Franck meets his fate…in the form of a quirky salesman named Victor, who offers him the gift of a lifetime. The gift is many lifetimes, actually, in many different worlds – each lasting just a few minutes. In the sequel to the pilot, Franck will find a new reason to live…in the form of a bewitching female adventurer named Tara, who awakens his long-lost lust for life. But can Franck keep up with her?
Metadata.tagline: Any life you ever wanted!

Metadata.title: Tears of Steel
Metadata.summary: Thom just wanted to be an astronaut. His girlfriend Celia just wanted to create robots - and for him to not be freaked out by her cyborg hand. How was Thom supposed to know that breaking up with her would make her take out her anger on the rest of humanity using her robots? It seems the only possible way of undoing everything...is to overwrite her memory of what happened 40 years ago.
Metadata.tagline: He just wanted to be awesome in space!
